item.title: Alteronce Gumby’s exhibition depicts earthly elements in a new light
item.description: The Anderson Collection’s exhibition of Alteronce Gumby’s paintings is the first display of the artist’s work on the West Coast. Introducing the viewers to a rich interplay between pigments, materials and light, the exhibition is open until March 1. The post Alteronce Gumby’s exhibition depicts earthly elements in a new light appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Stanford softball defeats No. 14 Oregon to close out Cardinal Classic I Tournament
item.description: Stanford softball beat Oregon this afternoon 5-4 to complete their 3-1 Cardinal Classic I tournament, bouncing back from a loss to Kentucky on Thursday afternoon. item.description: Teachers and the school district came to an agreement Friday, ending a historic strike in SF and resulting in raises, fully funded healthcare and other benefits. The post San Francisco teachers end four-day strike in $183 million deal appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.description: The OpenAI CEO urged hackers to treat AI not as a plug-in for existing workflows, but as a new primitive for rebuilding products from the ground up. The post Sam Altman projects AGI development, heightened AI integration in TreeHacks keynote appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
